thread:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — we're greenlighting a microlaunch for the Inference Unlocked webinar next Tue. Need: X thread, LinkedIn post, 200-300 seed accounts, 2 creative variants (gif + static), and engagement owners for 48h after launch. Draft snippets below.

Maya Patel: ```X thread (3 tweets):
1) Intro: "We just launched a deep-dive on production LLM inference — register: https://bit.ly/inf-unlocked"
2) Benchmark hook: "See how we hit 3x throughput and ~60% lower cost in real workloads — join the walk-through."
3) CTA: "Live demo + Q&A — register now: https://bit.ly/inf-unlocked"```

Sam Rivera: Love it. Can we A/B headline 2 — '3x throughput' vs '60% lower cost'? I'll pull the seed list and prep outreach tiers. ETA EOD today. :thumbsup:

Jordan Kim: For LinkedIn, tighten to one paragraph + CTA. Start with the benchmark line, then a 1-sentence proof, then CTA. I'll upload cleaned copy to Drive: https://drive.google.com/example (RD-team access). :eyes:

Lee Chen: Creative check — we can do gif tile + static 1200x628. Ops needs final images by Fri EOD to QA. Also confirm post timezones — PST or UTC?

Maya Patel: Proposed schedule: X thread at 10:30am PST Tue, LinkedIn at 11:00am PST. Ops, can you schedule both and add UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=microlaunch_q2?

Ops Bot: /schedule x-thread 2912920200 10:30 PST — queued (job id: 8472). /schedule linkedin-post 2912920800 11:00 PST — queued.

Sam Rivera: Seedlist plan: 250 targets to start (product + infra + platform engs), then tier 2 of 500 broader. Sending CSV to #sales-ops by 5pm. Will include top 40 VIPs for manual outreach.

Jordan Kim: Engagement play: 0-2h — organic replies + link to registration; 2-12h — amplify top replies; 24-48h — targeted DMs + workshop invite for engaged accounts. Who owns DMs? @Maya Patel?

Maya Patel: I'll own 0-6h reactive replies. Jordan you take 24-48h DMs. I'll update the launch doc with final copy, UTMs, and engagement script by Thu EOD. :rocket:

Lee Chen: Adding creative deadline to calendar. Quick ask: can we pin the primary tweet to the profile for 72h after launch? That should help discoverability.

Sam Rivera: No objections — pin it. Also recommend boosting one variant on day 2 to the VIP list if initial CTR is high.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Thanks everyone. Timeline: final copy + assets Thu EOD, Ops schedule Tue morning, engagement pulse Tue-Wed. I'll drop final links here when done. :handshake:
